root.name: Vulture Defense
root.moves: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 c5 3. d5 Ne4

overview: Black plays ...c5 and then 3...Ne4 after 3.d5, a knight sortie out of Benoni territory. White usually plays 4.Qd3 or 4.Nbd2 hitting the knight, and Black retreats or plays ...f5. Play is odd and a little loosening for Black.

white_ideas.idea: Kick the knight with Qd3 or Nd2 and gain space

black_ideas.idea: Retreat with ...Nf6 or support with ...d6 and ...f5
Aim for a Benoni with the knight active

typical_structures.structure: Benoni-like structure with White d5/c4 pawns

character.notes: Tricky early knight move, but not forcing.

soundness.notes: Black loses time kicking the knight back.

character.reason: It is unusual and unclear but not a forcing attack.

soundness.reason: White kicks the knight with tempo and gains space.

structure.reason: It is a Benoni-style asymmetric centre.

level.reason: A dubious line is not Beginner.

plans.reason: White takes space on the queenside and centre.
